snippet.title: Google Block Breaker - 10,000 Points in 1m 06s 617ms
snippet.description:
Google Block Breaker, released in January 2025, is a free browser-based arcade game inspired by classics like Breakout and Arkanoid. Developed by Google as a simple tech demo, it features clean visuals, smooth controls, and fast-paced gameplay.
The player controls a paddle to bounce a ball and clear blocks, with power-ups and level variations adding challenge and variety. The game is optimized for both desktop and mobile browsers, requiring no downloads or sign-in. To play it, search for "Block Breaker" on Google.
